Good questions

Sawaal? We've got you

When should I order for Diwali delivery?

Diwali falls on 8 November this year. For bulk orders, lock your quantity by mid-October. Single hampers — order by 1 November for metros, a few days earlier for smaller towns.

Can I add my company's branding?

Haan ji. Logo on the sleeve, personalised cards with your message, even custom box combos for larger orders. Tell us in the form.

What's the minimum for bulk pricing?

10 boxes. Share your quantity in the form and we'll send slab-wise pricing the same day.

Can I swap items in a hamper?

For bulk orders, yes — build your own combo from our full range. Single hampers ship as curated, because we've balanced them with love (and logic).

Do you deliver to multiple addresses?

Yes. Share your list and we'll handle doorstep delivery, city by city — one dashboard-level update for you, zero chaos.

How fresh are the products?

Packed fresh for the festive season, with best-before dates printed on every jar and pack. And every batch is lab-tested — reports are on our site.
